inlines.v: APOC'ALYPSE, noun apoc'alyps. [Gr. from to disclose; and to cover.] Revelation; discovery; disclosure. The name of a book of the New Testament, containing many discoveries or predictions respecting the future state of Christianity, written by St. John, in Patmos, near the close of the first century.
